items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: I don’t know if Ernie Wilkins — is Ernie still with us?

ctx.x: Isn’t Ernie Wilkins, I think he’s—
I don’t know if Ernie Wilkins — is Ernie still with us?
I thought so, the musician’s union had a Denmark address.
